description: This Java class implements an in-memory security store for LwM2M security information, supporting thread-safe operations to get, put, and remove security info by endpoint and identity.

classes.name: TbInMemorySecurityStore
classes.description: In-memory thread-safe store for LwM2M security information, supporting retrieval and modification by endpoint and PSK identity.

methods.name: getByEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves security info for a given endpoint, returning a default pre-shared key info if security mode is NO_SEC.

methods.name: getByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves security info for a given PSK identity.

methods.name: getByOscoreIdentity
methods.description: Stub method returning null for OscoreIdentity.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores security info, ensuring PSK identity uniqueness and updating internal maps accordingly.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes security info associated with a specific endpoint.

methods.name: getTbLwM2MSecurityInfoByEndpoint
methods.description: Returns security info for a specific endpoint.
